message:
I see. In both RAR 4 and RAR 5 formats, `PackSize` and `UnpSize` are read as unsigned values via `UINT32TO64`. So they can't be negative from parsing.

Wait, but the regression was about `if (Arc.FileHead.PackSize<0) Arc.FileHead.PackSize=0;` being commented out. Let me check where `PackSize` could become negative. Let me look at `ConvertFileHeader`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "ConvertFileHeader" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/arcread.cpp | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
